notes.title: Witch Slide Playtest Now Available!
notes.content:
Witch Slide Playtest is now available!

Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/9zQ33V4u9g]Discord community[/url] to provide feedback and find other plays for coop.


In Playtest there are 9 playable levels that will be in the final game.

[list]
[*] 5 Tutorial levels
[*] 2 Forest levels
[*] 1 Boss level
[*] 1 Spooky level
[/list]

[b]Goodluck![/b]
